text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from about 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling time and fewer notes typed in parking lots.

**2. CRM quality improved.** Next steps and stakeholders were captured consistently, so pipeline reviews got sharper.

**3. Trust took work.** Some customers hesitated at first. Asking consent upfront, and explaining why, turned most concerns into non-issues.

**4. Summaries aren't strategy.** The tool captured what was said, not what it meant. Reps still had to read between the lines.

**5. Adoption followed managers.** Teams whose leads used the notes in coaching stuck with it.

Would we keep it? Yes, with guardrails.

What has your team learned from AI note-takers?
